implementations.name: TORAX (google-deepmind/torax)
implementations.versionOrRevision: UNPINNED: pin a tagged release or commit hash and record install method and date at execution; until pinned this record is incomplete

read: repository README, fetched 2026-09-21 by the research stage (inherited; not re-fetched in the spec stage)
readStatus.consequence: Every TORAX convention below is known-of from general literature familiarity and is marked unverified; each must be confirmed against the pinned release before any comparison. The research note's statement that TORAX applies zero-Dirichlet n = T = 0 at rho = 1 is not relied on.

implementations.comparisonPlan: Run D2's verification-only kernel (Dirichlet edge with a closure exact for quadratics, prescribed identical Gaussian sources) and a pinned TORAX on matched circular-geometry benchmarks B0-B3 (theta = 1, constant uniform transport, electron-ion exchange disabled in both, no current diffusion, no neural surrogate, time step at least four times finer than the D2 step for TORAX), on a common analysis grid with SI conversion at the comparison layer; report metrics against the illustrative tolerances below after a TORAX self-convergence study fixes the working tolerance before comparing; treat the closed-form solution as a third anchor. See specs/proposals/d2-profiles-reference.md sections 2-5.

commonBenchmarkRules.referenceSettings: theta = 1, uniform constant transport, exchange disabled, no current diffusion, no neural surrogate, fixed steps at least 4x finer than the D2 step

tolerancePolicy.provenance: illustrative starting values set from the expected accuracy of second-order schemes on comparable grids; not fitted, not derived from a read TORAX result
tolerancePolicy.workingTolerance: max(listed value, 3 x TORAX self-convergence difference at doubled resolution), recorded before comparing
tolerancePolicy.adjustment: tolerances may not be adjusted after seeing the comparison
tolerancePolicy.threeWay: if D2 and the reference disagree, whichever differs from the closed form is the suspect

expectedDifferences: Coordinate: rho_tor^2 versus rho_V^2 differ by about 5% at r = a/2 on the T-DIII-D tier (hand check, 0.237 versus 0.250) and at most about 0.2% on T-large (hand estimate); structural, not an error
Metric: D2's constant 1/L^2 versus geometry-supplied metrics; reported by B0
Mesh, mesh spacing and solver choices; bounded by the reference self-convergence study
Source normalisation: D2's discrete sum h_i dV_i = 1 versus the reference's own normalisation of Gaussian totals (unverified); compare integrated source power first

nonComparable.item: production edge-flux closure (prescribed flux equal to the 0-D loss, no edge value)
nonComparable.reason: no reference-code counterpart: TORAX-type codes impose boundary values; only the verification-only Dirichlet edge maps. The production edge is tested by D2's own parity and ledger checks and experimentally by validation falsifier F-6 (DD-5)
a self-consistent code has no 0-D authority; parity is an internal consistency property of D2

nonComparable.item: physical source models (NBI, ECH, gas, Ohmic with jt, bremsstrahlung)
nonComparable.reason: D2's are illustrative shapes with renormalised totals and the reference's source models differ; benchmarks use identical prescribed Gaussians instead

nonComparable.item: reference turbulent surrogate, current diffusion, self-consistent geometry evolution
nonComparable.reason: no D2 counterpart; using any of them puts a benchmark outside this pathway
D2's profile grid is independent of psi and of the equilibrium solve
diagnostics of a flux-closed edge; in the reference the edge value is an input

implementations.executionAndAccess: Python environment able to install the pinned TORAX, run outside the repository (no new runtime dependency, no LLM or orchestration in the web app); configuration and result files saved under an evidence path assigned by the Director; Validation (claude-opus) reviews. Depends on the D2 kernel's verification-only entry. Status: not started, blocked on the Software implementation and on pinning the reference version.
